text:
Gabe: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for questions about the sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partnerships — drop Qs here and we'll answer live. Top priorities: improve net-new velocity, scale partner-led enterprise, and clarify pricing for Dedicated/Private.

Tom: Quick Q — what's the official net-new ARR goal for Q2? I heard different numbers in breakout.

Anika (CRO): Goal is $2.2M net-new ARR for Q2. We expect about ~800k to be partner-influenced. We baked conservative ramp and conversion assumptions into the plan.

Tom: Got it. Any quota changes or territory reshuffle we should know about? :eyes: 

Anika (CRO): No quota reset mid-quarter. We'll reassign ~3 accounts/AE to balance workloads; RevOps will notify impacted reps this week. Major territory changes will start next quarter.

Lina: For partner-sourced deals, how is credit assigned? Does AE still own the relationship?

Priya (Head of Partnerships): Short answer: yes. Partner-sourced deals get partner referral credit; AE retains primary ACV credit if they run the close. We're standardizing an 80/20 attribution for net-new partner-sourced deals. Influence deals are tracked differently. I'll post the attribution doc.

Ben (RevOps): Funnel snapshot: MQL->SQL 18% (down 3pt MoM), SQL->OPP 24%, OPP->CW 22%. Lead quality dip is the main gap — running an AB on messaging to address it.

Ben (RevOps): AB test on new outreach is live, results in ~2 weeks. cc @Tom @Anika

Priya (Head of Partnerships): AWS Marketplace status: final review, target launch mid-May. Azure Marketplace aiming for Q3. Also piloting co-sell with two systems integrators — partner enablement next week.

Lina: Customer asks on Dedicated/Private pricing — any changes or new discount guidance for term deals?

Anika (CRO): Pricing is mostly unchanged. We published an "enterprise term" playbook: discount bands tied to commit level and deployment type (private deployments qualify for higher thresholds). I'll share the TL;DR.

Gabe: On GTM focus for the quarter — three motions: 1) product-led land & expand, 2) partner-assisted enterprise for regulated customers, 3) performance-led SMB upsell using Redwood Optimize. Use these to prioritize inbound.

Tom: Can RevOps/PD put together a one-pager playbook per motion for SDRs/AEs?

Anika (CRO): Yes — RevOps to deliver a one-pager for each motion by next Wed. Action assigned to Ben.

allhands-bot: Slides and Q&A notes uploaded → https://drive.redwood.company/allhands/1767584123-q1-sales-pipeline.pdf :page_facing_up:

Priya (Head of Partnerships): Partner action: shared commission matrix + enablement checklist in #partners channel. @Lina please review and flag anything missing.

Lina: Reviewing now, will comment by EOD.

Gabe: Thanks team — if anything blocks deals >$250k, DM me directly. Appreciate the quick follow-ups :thumbsup:
